---
id: platypus
title: Platypus
---
The platypus (*Ornithorhynchus anatinus*) is a monotreme: it lays eggs,
then nurses. The bill is packed with electroreceptors that pick up the
tiny fields of aquatic invertebrates in murky streams of eastern
Australia. Males carry a venomous spur. Fur traps air for cool water.
Daytime is often spent in a bank burrow.
